# A Major

A Major is a software company for the agent era, based in Singapore and serving clients worldwide. It operates two arms: Agency and Products.

**Website:** https://amajor.ai
**Email:** contact@amajor.ai
**Location:** Singapore (serving clients worldwide)

---

## Agency

> Software that just works. Experts you can talk to.

A Major Agency builds websites, apps, and enterprise systems with AI agents at the core. Founded by Jia Wei Ng, the agency is fully founder-led — no subcontracting, no project managers relaying messages, direct access to the person building your product.

### Services

- **Web Design** — Custom websites, mobile-first, Core Web Vitals optimised. https://amajor.ai/services/web-design
- **Web Apps** — Full-stack React/Next.js applications. https://amajor.ai/services/web-apps
- **Mobile Apps** — React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Flutter. https://amajor.ai/services/mobile-apps
- **SaaS Products** — Multi-tenant SaaS with billing and auth. https://amajor.ai/services/saas-products
- **Enterprise Systems** — ERP, CRM, internal tooling at scale. https://amajor.ai/services/enterprise-systems
- **API & MCP Development** — REST, GraphQL, tRPC, Model Context Protocol servers. https://amajor.ai/services/api-development
- **DevOps** — CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud deployments. https://amajor.ai/services/devops
- **Engineering Consultancy** — Fractional CTO, architecture reviews, technical advisory. https://amajor.ai/services/consultancy
- **MVP Scoping** — Product discovery, technical architecture, roadmap. https://amajor.ai/services/mvp-scoping
- **Digital Transformation** — Modernise operations with software. https://amajor.ai/services/digital-transformation
- **Legacy Modernisation** — Migrate and refactor legacy systems. https://amajor.ai/services/legacy-modernisation

### Agency Differentiators

- Fixed scope, no billing surprises
- Direct access to the founder
- Fast turnaround — finished product inside 30 days
- Design, engineering, and project management in one team
- Full deployment included
- Post-launch support available
- Clean, documented handover
- No subcontracting, ever
- Weekly progress updates
- You own everything we build

### Who This Is For

- Founders who need a technical co-founder or first engineering hire
- Businesses replacing spreadsheets and manual processes with software
- Teams who've been burned by agencies that overpromise and underdeliver
- Companies modernising legacy systems
- Startups building MVPs with real engineering quality

## Products

> Most AI agents didn't deliver. We build the ones that do.

Industry research puts real enterprise value from AI agents under 10%. A Major Products builds agent-native software — not retrofitted AI wrappers — starting with Ryu.

### Ryu

Ryu is end-to-end managed infrastructure for AI agents.

Pick your engine — Hermes, OpenClaw, ZeroClaw, Claude Code, or any compatible agent — and Ryu is the entire car built around them: security, model routing, memory, tools, workflows, and deployment. All sourced, assembled, and managed.

- **Product page:** https://amajor.ai/products/ryu
- **Homepage:** https://ryuhq.com

**Why Ryu:** Most teams spend 80% of their AI budget on plumbing — auth, memory, routing, observability — and 20% on the actual agent logic. Ryu inverts that.

---

## Company

### Manifesto

A Major believes software should work for the people using it, not the agency billing for it. The Manifesto outlines the principles behind how A Major builds: scope first, ship fast, handover clean, no surprises.

Full manifesto: https://amajor.ai/manifesto

### Story

A Major was founded by Jia Wei Ng, a software engineer with 7+ years of experience building production systems. After watching too many businesses pay for software they couldn't maintain, understand, or grow with, the agency was built on the opposite principle: founder-led, direct, honest.

Full story: https://amajor.ai/story

### Founder
